title: Retire the empty historical DAWN font stub without removing real fonts

source.ref: Only deployable designs require runtime font modules; resolveDesign normalizes DAWN to Frequency

detail: The historical DAWN font module registered no faces and had no runtime importer. Only a test looping every historical DESIGNS entry required its existence; migrate that contract to designs actually deployable through the canonical resolver, then remove the empty module. Keep the historical registry entry, all actual Frequency faces, root shared base registrations, skin and saved-data compatibility unchanged. Actual generator subprocesses in disposable fixtures normalize retired, unknown and unset selections without the stub and remain idempotent; reverting canonical DAWN normalization fails on the same absent-module fixture. The bounded probe holds the empty module absent and the actual font registrations present. Owner successor HYG187 remains open for legacy CSS retirement after SCAN1130 was closed on its narrower declaration probe; no platform CSS, next/font registration, database or provider operation changes.
